title: Configuration
requirement: SHALL maintain a versioned asset and installed-module inventory linking CAD reference, mass/CG budget, interface revision and model/software versions.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect a baseline record and demonstrate identification of every installed module.

title: Telemetry
requirement: SHALL publish timestamped navigation, energy, propulsion, environment, faults and maintenance state with units, source, quality and configuration identity.
acceptance_criterion: Replay an annotated dataset; every required field has units, timestamp, provenance and a defined invalid/stale state.

title: Local safety
requirement: SHALL keep emergency propulsion stop and essential local control available during WAN, cloud and AI service loss.
acceptance_criterion: Inject WAN/cloud/AI loss and demonstrate local stop and control according to the approved safe-state table.

title: Open interfaces
requirement: SHALL document versioned mechanical, power, data and command contracts with compatible-module rules, vendor adapters, authorized data export and component license records.
acceptance_criterion: Review contracts for mounting/load limits, connectors, power limits, message schemas, authority and version compatibility.

title: Marine models
requirement: SHALL link hull, structure, propulsion, thermal, control and mission models through documented Modelica/co-simulation interfaces.
acceptance_criterion: Run a reproducible coupled scenario with recorded model versions, exchanged units and time-step settings.

title: Hydrostatics
requirement: SHALL define displacement, draft, freeboard, trim, buoyancy and stability for each approved loading configuration.
acceptance_criterion: Produce a signed loading-case analysis against criteria established before baseline approval; no inferred dimensions from the image.

title: Structural integrity
requirement: SHALL define load paths, compartmentation, penetrations, drainage, service access and corrosion/environment protection for hull, deck and module attachments.
acceptance_criterion: Review load-case calculations and inspect a compartment/penetration/access drawing against the approved design criteria.

title: Energy protection
requirement: SHALL provide protected power distribution, emergency isolation, source/load metering and reserve prioritization for essential loads.
acceptance_criterion: Verify the mission energy balance and inject source/bus faults; protected loads follow the approved reserve and isolation policy.

title: Human safety
requirement: SHALL define occupancy, access, emergency egress, fire/flooding response and human authority over automated functions.
acceptance_criterion: Walk through each occupancy configuration and demonstrate egress and manual takeover against the approved hazard controls.

title: Cybersecurity
requirement: SHALL authenticate remote commands, enforce permissions and local interlocks, record command/update provenance, and define location/occupant data minimization and retention.
acceptance_criterion: Reject unauthorized/out-of-envelope commands; verify authorized actions are logged and location/occupant access and retention follow the approved privacy policy.

title: Twin verification
requirement: SHALL compare digital-twin state with measured/reference state and define accuracy, latency, staleness and offline recovery criteria.
acceptance_criterion: Replay normal, stale-data and reconnect cases against an approved error/latency budget with a pass/fail report.

title: Operating envelope
requirement: SHALL establish environmental, speed, load and maintenance limits before prototype envelope expansion.
acceptance_criterion: Approve an envelope table and staged trial entry/exit criteria; record evidence for each demonstrated condition.

title: Twin-hull platform
requirement: SHALL provide two demi-hulls, bridge deck and cabin/mission mounting structure with controlled module mass and CG.
acceptance_criterion: Verify the arrangement against the twin-hull CAD callout and analyze all module loading cases.

title: Modular propulsion
requirement: SHALL provide replaceable marine electric propulsion modules with command, feedback, fault, isolation and maintenance interfaces.
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate steering/thrust control, safe stop and module interface inspection using the selected propulsor configuration.

title: Mission modules
requirement: SHALL define installation and removal interfaces for passenger, cargo, research, surveillance, environmental and emergency modules.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect interface contracts and demonstrate at least one module change; validate mass/CG, retention, power/data and safety per variant.

title: Passenger accommodation
requirement: SHALL provide configurable passenger spaces with access, seating, safety provisions and approved occupancy.
acceptance_criterion: Review a passenger arrangement and demonstrate boarding/egress for the approved occupancy and accessibility criteria.

title: Perception and helm
requirement: SHALL integrate GNSS/AIS, attitude and environmental sensing, with selected radar/camera/LiDAR interfaces and a local helm/HMI.
acceptance_criterion: Replay sensor loss and obstacle scenarios; verify displayed validity, operator authority and the approved degraded response.

title: Energy variants
requirement: SHALL define a battery-electric base and separately selectable hybrid/hydrogen energy modules with protected mounting and distribution.
acceptance_criterion: Review base and candidate variant diagrams; quantify energy, mass/CG and hazard impact before accepting a variant.

title: Renewable option
requirement: SHALL treat photovoltaic generation as a candidate option until array area, installation and electrical interfaces are designed.
acceptance_criterion: Resolve the filename-only solar assumption with an approved roof/deck arrangement, yield/shading analysis and protected conversion design.

title: Amphibious option
requirement: SHALL keep land mobility, landing gear and water-land transitions outside the illustrated baseline until a dedicated design is approved.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect scope and baseline: no unapproved wheel/gear implementation or land-performance claim; variant approval requires geometry and load analysis.

title: Mission handling
requirement: SHALL define safe cargo/module handling and ground/sea vehicle interfaces before enabling automated loading.
acceptance_criterion: Review retention, load transfer and operator exclusion zones; demonstrate the approved handling sequence with fault interruption.

title: Living module
requirement: SHALL provide configurable sleeping, seating, galley, sanitation, storage and workspace for an approved occupancy.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect a habitation arrangement against the CAD living-space callouts and demonstrate access/egress.

title: Roof deck and PV
requirement: SHALL separate roof leisure/workspace access from photovoltaic arrays and provide guarded access and controlled structural loads.
acceptance_criterion: Analyze occupied roof loads, CG and stability; inspect guards, access and PV maintenance clearances.

title: Battery and conversion
requirement: SHALL provide modular battery banks and protected inverter/DC-AC interfaces; evaluate the depicted LiFePO4 chemistry as a candidate selection.
acceptance_criterion: Review chemistry selection, mounting, thermal/protection design and source-fault shutdown against the approved criteria.

title: Electric marine drive
requirement: SHALL provide modular electric marine propulsion and local steering/stop with propulsion health telemetry.
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate maneuvering and emergency stop plus timestamped command/state/fault telemetry in the approved water envelope.

title: Water and waste
requirement: SHALL separate potable, grey and black water tanks, plumbing and service interfaces; monitor levels and prevent cross-connection.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect independent circuits and demonstrate level alarms, leak response and service access against the approved capacities.

title: Climate and utilities
requirement: SHALL provide ventilation, HVAC, lighting and essential habitation loads within the energy reserve and thermal budgets.
acceptance_criterion: Verify climate and power budgets for approved occupancy/environment conditions and demonstrate priority-load behavior.

title: Navigation and IoT
requirement: SHALL integrate GPS/GNSS, AIS, selected camera/radar and environment/security sensors into local navigation and monitoring.
acceptance_criterion: Replay navigation/sensor faults and verify validity flags, alarms and safe local operation.

title: Remote access
requirement: SHALL provide authorized remote monitoring and open APIs over selected cellular or optional satellite links with local buffering.
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate authorized access, disconnected operation and ordered reconnect without duplicate command execution.

title: Land-water variant
requirement: SHALL define towing/chassis, road interfaces and launch/recovery only after a dedicated land configuration is designed.
acceptance_criterion: Record land capability as unresolved; acceptance requires transport geometry, mass, coupling/braking and transition load evidence.

title: Dashboard provenance
requirement: SHALL treat illustrated energy/water percentages, location and 5.2 kn speed as UI examples rather than performance or capacity limits.
acceptance_criterion: Verify examples are labeled and replaced by measured or simulated values carrying quality and provenance.

title: River hull and decks
requirement: SHALL provide the illustrated river-vessel hull and multiple accommodation decks with controlled loading, access and structural load paths.
acceptance_criterion: Inspect a deck arrangement and analyze hull/deck loads and stability for each approved passenger/module configuration.

title: Passenger operation
requirement: SHALL define cabins/common areas, configurable passenger modules, occupancy, accessible boarding and emergency egress.
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate boarding and egress against an approved arrangement and occupancy plan.

title: Energy and drive
requirement: SHALL define modular battery banks and an electric base drive with separately assessed hybrid/hydrogen alternatives.
acceptance_criterion: Analyze propulsion and hotel demand for a river mission; demonstrate isolation and reserve control for the selected configuration.

title: River navigation
requirement: SHALL provide local navigation/HMI and supervised autonomy interfaces using GNSS/AIS, selected perception and environmental sensors.
acceptance_criterion: Replay current, shallow-water, docking and sensor-loss cases within the approved envelope and verify manual takeover.

title: Interchangeable missions
requirement: SHALL define passenger, cargo, research, surveillance, environmental and emergency module interfaces with retained loading records.
acceptance_criterion: Review mounting, handling, power/data and mass/CG contracts; demonstrate one approved module substitution.

title: ROV/AUV option
requirement: SHALL define an optional ROV/AUV launch, recovery and data interface before enabling research deployment.
acceptance_criterion: Analyze handling loads and exclusion zones; demonstrate recovery and emergency interruption for the selected equipment.

title: River environment
requirement: SHALL assess draft/under-keel clearance, current, wind, bank interaction and wave effects for the intended waterway and loading cases.
acceptance_criterion: Produce an approved waterway envelope and compare maneuvering predictions with staged controlled trials.

title: Hotel loads
requirement: SHALL include accommodation HVAC, lighting, water/waste and passenger services in power, safety and maintenance budgets.
acceptance_criterion: Review service arrangements and calculate hotel/essential-load budgets for the approved occupancy.
